title: Codex built a Counter Strike clone (kind of). With multiplayer using web-rtc
author: MR1933
selftext:
I wanted to stress test an autonomous coding framework I’m working on and decided to ask it to build a counter strike 1.5 like browser FPS

I just wrote a [goal.md](http://goal.md/) describing what I wanted plus the aceptance criteria. About 90% of the game itself was implemented by codex in multiple turns driven by the framework. The initial commit took about 4 hours.

Obviously the graphics are nothing like the original, since I did not use any pre built 3d asset, but the feel of the game is surprisingly close for a two shot codex implementation.

Then I decided to add multiplayer mode, and it actually works pretty well. You can play with your friends on LAN using web-rtc and latency is super low, or you can play on different ISPs, albeit it will be slower.

Third time's the charm. Reddit kept deleting / shadowing the link to the game, so I put it on a real domain now. Looking for people to join my room for an online match:

[https://csmini.mrauter.com/?room=A7CM7L&map=sandline-foundry](https://csmini.mrauter.com/?room=A7CM7L&map=sandline-foundry)
